explanation: A key structural fact is that for semisimple $\mathfrak{g}$ every nonzero root space is one-dimensional. The Cartan subalgebra $\mathfrak{h}$ (the zero-weight space) has dimension equal to the rank $r$, but the $\mathfrak{g}_\alpha$ are lines, so the choices referencing $r$ or $\dim\mathfrak{h}$ confuse $\mathfrak{h}$ with a root space.
